test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following did Rowlatt Act 1919 entail?

options.text: Indefinite detention without trial and censorship of the press
Open fire and lathi-charge on Indians

solution:
Correct answer is__** Indefinite detention without trial and censorship of the press.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rowlatt Acts, (February 1919), **legislation proceeded by the Imperial Legislative Council, the legislature of British India.
 
• The acts **allowed definite political cases to be tried without juries and permitted internment of suspects without trial**.
 
• The Rowlatt Act was proceeded by the British government **to grow their grasp on power over the common folk**.
 
• This act** allow the British government to arrest anybody suspected of terrorist activities.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTYdmngSIbWoi9vaKoqaa37_shznJqV8Sn-xA&usqp=CAU] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Employing 'lathi charge' to crush protests and demonstrations has been inherited from the legal structure used by the **colonial police.**
